title: Carlus Magnus — Les éclats d’Aurore
description: A fast-paced 2D melee platformer made for Charles. Explore twelve connected areas, climb giant guardians and duel five bosses through three phases. Choose an archetype or build your own hero, wield sword, axe or spear, and discover twelve talents and six talismans. Three difficulties include Master, with hidden attack zones by default. French in-game text.
controls: Jump / double jump: Space or Up
Attack: J or X; downward attack: Down + attack in the air
Guard / parry: K or C; dodge: Shift or L
Talents: Tab; talismans: I; map: M; pause: Escape or P
credits: Cédric Bernadac — creative direction and playtesting feedback.
Nilo (Codex) — game design, programming, original Canvas artwork, synthesized audio and testing.
Created for Charles. No third-party game assets or code copied.
